title: 第7章 灵液分配第8章 灵睿聚气
content_zh:
半个时辰过后，杨灵清在浓郁灵气的浸润下，也成功入定，并于一个时辰后完成了引气。
剩下的杨灵虎，也没有花太久时间，两个时辰引气成功。
半天下来，杨家三个孩子全都引气入体成功。
这样的结果大大超出了杨贯峰和余老的预料。
“想当年，我可是花了整整三日时间才好不容易引气入体啊。”
杨贯峰来到阁楼，感慨道。
余老笑笑：“家主当年都已经二十多岁，过了修炼的最佳年纪，而且这次娃娃们入定引气如此之快，大半都得归功于聚灵石的存在。”
说着，他指了指陈阳。
陈阳闻言在心间点点头，暗道一句：确实。
“此物让阁楼内充盈了浓郁灵气，能够让人平心静气，更好的进行入定冥想。”
“这件灵宝将是我杨家起势的大功臣，日后若有机会，定要用秘法来好生温养祭炼。”
陈阳一听表示：兄弟你这想法可以的，我赞成。
四个时辰之后，也是到了黄昏时分，余老停止了对陈阳的灵气灌注。
三个孩子也是从冥想状态中缓缓苏醒。
这第一天修炼的结果，杨灵睿完全冲开了第一处气节，正在朝第二处努力。
杨灵清即将冲开第一处，还差几分功夫。
杨灵虎完成了第一处气节的一半。
这样得结果让杨灵虎有些沮丧，返回禁地厢房休息时有些垂头丧气。
“嘿！虎子，你在这丧气什么呢！”
杨灵清敏锐的察觉了这点，上前便拍了一下他的后背。

杨灵虎有气无力，一脸愁容的说道：“我落后你们太多了，以后可怎么办啊...”
“你瞧瞧你，还好灵睿已经回房，不然看了你这副德行，哪里还有做哥哥的样子。”
杨灵虎甩了甩头，坐到了门檐上，用手撑着下巴。
“小清，你说的在理，我都能明白，但我这心里就是有点堵，不得劲呐。”
杨灵清见状也是并排和他坐下，两人一块抬头望着天空。
“虎子，你忘了余老祖的话吗？”
“修炼这条路对我们来说还长着呢，一时的快慢并不会决定最终取得的成就。”
“这一路上的影响因素有很多，除了资质以外，根骨、悟性、气运、甚至那虚无缥缈的命数，都在其中。”
说着，杨灵清拍了拍杨灵虎的肩膀。
“虎子，灵睿和我们不一样，我想你也能够看出来。”
“就像老祖说的那样，我们都是在为杨家奋斗，看看你我的父亲，虽然不得修炼之法，但同样能够为老祖分忧，将家里上上下下打理利索。”
“我们总归是有自己能做和要做的事情，只要做好自己份内的事，尽力而为便可，不必过多烦恼。”
经过杨灵清的一番开导，原本心中有些郁郁的愁思也被扫尽。
他像是有所悟般的望着天空的云朵，口中喃喃着先前余老说过的那句话。
“当勤勉，当努力。”
“嗯，看来你想明白了啊。”杨灵清笑道。
“哈哈哈哈。”
此刻杨灵虎又恢复了往日的开朗：“要不说还得是小清呢，说话总是这么头头是道的，真是厉害！”
被夸奖后得杨灵清有些小得意，扬了扬头上的小辫子。
也在这时，她的脸上终是露出了属于这个年纪，单纯美好的模样。

从这一日开始，杨灵虎三人便常住在了禁地内。
所有的日常用品和餐食，都由余老为他们提供，同时也是每天带着他们修炼。
陈阳的任务也很简单，每天到了点就去阁楼打卡上班，开始聚拢灵气。
时间一到就下班，然后被杨贯峰收走，带回房间用灵力温养。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Yang Lingqing successfully entered meditation under the infiltration of rich spiritual energy, and completed the Qi induction an hour later.
The remaining Yang Linghu didn't spend too long, and succeeded in drawing Qi in two hours.
After a long time, all three children of the Yang family successfully introduced Qi into their bodies.
This result greatly exceeded Yang Guanfeng and Yu Lao's expectations.
"I think back then, it took me three whole days to finally get the gas into my body."
Yang Guanfeng came to the attic and sighed.
Mr. Yu smiled: "The head of the family was already in his twenties at the time, and was past the best age for cultivation. Moreover, the fact that the children entered meditation so quickly this time is mostly due to the existence of the spirit-gathering stone."
As he spoke, he pointed at Chen Yang.
When Chen Yang heard this, he nodded in his heart and said to himself: Indeed.
"This object fills the attic with rich spiritual energy, which can calm people down and allow them to better meditate."
"This spiritual treasure will be a great contributor to the rise of my Yang family. If there is an opportunity in the future, I will definitely use secret methods to nourish, nourish and refine it."
Upon hearing this, Chen Yang said: Brother, your idea is okay, I agree.
Four hours later, at dusk, Mr. Yu stopped pouring spiritual energy into Chen Yang.
The three children also slowly woke up from their meditative state.
As a result of this first day of practice, Yang Lingrui has completely broken through the first point of strength and is working hard towards the second point.
Yang Lingqing was about to break through to the first place, but still had a few seconds to go.
Yang Linghu completed half of the first Qi Festival.
This result made Yang Linghu a little depressed, and he was a little downcast when he returned to the forbidden room to rest.
"Hey! Huzi, why are you so frustrated here!"
Yang Lingqing was keenly aware of this and stepped forward to pat him on the back.
Yang Linghu was weak and said with a sad look on his face: "I am too far behind you, what will I do in the future..."
"Look at you, luckily Lingrui has returned to the room, otherwise I wouldn't look like an elder brother with your behavior."
Yang Linghu shook his head, sat on the door eaves, and supported his chin with his hand.
"Xiao Qing, what you said makes sense and I can understand it, but I just feel a little stuck in my heart and feel uncomfortable."
When Yang Lingqing saw this, he also sat down side by side with him, and the two of them looked up at the sky.
"Huzi, have you forgotten what Patriarch Yu said?"
"The path of cultivation is still long for us. The speed of the moment will not determine the final achievements."
"There are many influencing factors along the way. In addition to qualifications, one's ability, understanding, luck, and even the elusive destiny are all among them."
With that said, Yang Lingqing patted Yang Linghu's shoulder.
"Huzi, Lingrui is different from us, I think you can see that."
"Just like the ancestor said, we are all fighting for the Yang family. Look at your father and I. Although we don't know how to practice, we can still share the worries of our ancestors and take care of the house."
"We always have things we can do and do. As long as we do our part and do our best, we don't have to worry too much."
After Yang Lingqing's enlightenment, some of the gloomy thoughts in his heart were swept away.
He looked at the clouds in the sky as if he had some enlightenment, and murmured the words that Mr. Yu had said before.
"Be diligent and work hard."
"Well, it seems you have figured it out." Yang Lingqing smiled.
"Hahahaha."
At this moment, Yang Linghu returned to his usual cheerfulness: "It's Xiao Qing who always speaks so clearly and truthfully. It's really amazing!"
After being praised, Yang Lingqing felt a little proud and raised her pigtails.
At this time, her face finally showed the pure and beautiful look that belongs to her age.
From this day on, Yang Linghu and the others lived in the forbidden area.
All daily necessities and meals were provided by Mr. Yu, who also took them to practice every day.
Chen Yang’s missionIt’s also very simple. When the time comes every day, go to the attic to clock in and start gathering spiritual energy.
As soon as the time was up, he got off work and was taken away by Yang Guanfeng and brought back to his room to be nourished with spiritual power.
